newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Dollar to consolidate then climb again.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Dollar to consolidate then climb again.

text.p: The dollar has pulled back slightly after striding to a 45-month high of 116.40 yen on Tuesday, and is now settling into consolidation, chart watchers said. In the near term, the U.S. currency may extend its losses to the 115.10-40 area but should encounter significant support around 114.90, the high from late October, analysts said. "Unless we saw a break back down below 114.90, we're probably likely to just consolidate around the highs for now," said a technical analyst at a U.S. bank in London.
The dollar was quoted at 115.87/97 yen at 0859 GMT compared to 115.88/93 in late Europe on Tuesday.
